parameters.query:
SELECT id, tenant_id, company_name, stripe_api_key, slack_webhook_url, slack_channel
FROM tenant_configs
WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $json.tenant_id }}'
  AND is_active = TRUE;

INSERT INTO tenant_payment_runs (
  tenant_id, stripe_event_id, payment_intent_id,
  amount_cents, currency, customer_email,
  tenant_lookup_status, stripe_fetch_status, slack_post_status, slack_error,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.tenant_id }}',
  '{{ $json.stripe_event_id }}',
  '{{ $json.payment_intent_id }}',
  {{ $json.amount_cents }},
  '{{ $json.currency }}',
  NULL,
  'success',
  'success',
  '{{ $json.slack_status }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.slack_error || "" }}', ''),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (stripe_event_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
